claims.claim: Free trials for game passes launch for players on December 2, 2026, in the in-game Shop.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026). Direct fetch of devforum.roblox.com is blocked by the sandbox policy; corroborated by endgametools, thegamescabin, wisevoter and bloxcodehub, all quoting the official announcement.

claims.claim: On a pass whose creator turned trials on, a Try button appears in the Shop next to Buy.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools, thegamescabin and wisevoter.

claims.claim: A trial unlocks everything the pass gives for one full game session, with a minimum duration of one hour.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools, bloxcodehub, thegamescabin and wisevoter.

claims.claim: Each player gets one free trial per pass, and only one trial can be active at a time.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools, bloxcodehub, thegamescabin and wisevoter.

claims.claim: If the game crashes or the session ends because of a system error, the trial continues when the player rejoins within one hour.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools, thegamescabin and galixor. Verified but NOT in the narration (word budget) — belongs in the publish.md description.

claims.claim: A pass the player already owns offers no trial.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools and bloxcodehub.

claims.claim: Creators can turn free trials on for their passes since November 18, in Creator Hub (Monetization → Shop → Free Trials), pass by pass or all at once, for passes on sale; new passes start with trials off.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools, thegamescabin and galixor.

claims.claim: Buying the pass during the trial keeps it permanently; if the session ends without a purchase, the pass's benefits stop.
claims.notes: Primary source: Roblox Developer Forum post 'Introducing Pass Free Trials' (Nov 18, 2026); corroborated by endgametools and thegamescabin.
